name: palettepresets-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `palettePresets` flag (pro tier, nested inside the already simple-tier `masterPalette` editor in FinishPicker): the 'Palette presets' gallery is absent in Simple mode (masterPalette editor still renders) and present in Pro; a real click on a preset button applies it via the normal setMasterPalette action (undoable).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: open-palette-disclosure
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector summary')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().includes('Apartment colour palette')); if (!s) throw new Error('Apartment colour palette <summary> not found'); const d = s.closest('details'); if (!d.open) s.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-disclosure-open
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector summary')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().includes('Apartment colour palette')); const d = s.closest('details'); if (!d.open) throw new Error('Apartment colour palette <details> did not open'); })()

steps.name: assert-master-palette-visible-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Apartment palette')) throw new Error('Apartment palette editor (masterPalette, simple tier) missing in Simple mode: ' + t.slice(0,300)); })()

steps.name: assert-presets-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Palette presets')) throw new Error('Palette presets gallery visible in Simple mode (should be Pro-only)'); })()

steps.name: assert-presets-visible-pro
steps.failMessage: Palette presets gallery missing in Pro mode

steps.name: click-scandi-preset
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.pal-preset[aria-label="Apply the Scandinavian calm palette preset"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Scandinavian calm preset button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-palette-applied
steps.failMessage: masterPalette did not update to the Scandinavian calm preset colours after clicking the preset button

steps.name: assert-presets-hidden-simple-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Palette presets')) throw new Error('Palette presets gallery visible after switching back to Simple mode'); if (!t.includes('Apartment palette')) throw new Error('Apartment palette editor unexpectedly missing after switching back to Simple'); })()
